summary: Implemented `py:type` aliases with optional `canonical` expressions, Python type parsing, alias target registration, cross-reference roles, and module/class-aware index entries. Added documentation, a `CHANGES.rst` note, and regression coverage. Focused Python-domain tests passed: 66 passed; `git diff --check` passed. The test run emitted one existing LibreSSL/urllib3 warning. I did not run the full test suite.
